name: AI-generated code
description: Code produced by the agent that is fast and useful for obvious or routine tasks, but prone to fragility, standardization, and architectural drift without strong oversight.

edges.quote: developers keep saying that reviewing AI-generated code requires more effort than reviewing code written by their colleagues.
the defenses we relied on (code review, testing, manual inspection) are the same ones that missed Heartbleed for two years
AI’s instinct to normalize was actively harmful there, and those were the parts I had to design in depth and often resorted to just writing myself
Several times during the project, I lost my mental model of the codebase
AI didn’t just make the same project faster. It changed what the project was
